outputs: Input-only SUCCESS route with item collected and 17.98 seconds remaining.

The final controller climbs the warmup step at x=244.36/y=291, lands on the elevated platform at x=466.55/y=245.93, jumps the hazard, collects the item, and reaches SUCCESS at x=1030.22.
The script never assigns player.position/global_position and never invokes internal collection or finish methods.
